vbaSource:

  For i = 1 To 10

End Sub

End Sub

vbaSource:

description: Exit For in a nested loop only exits the nearest (inner) loop
vbaSource:
Sub Scenario()
  count = 0
  For i = 1 To 3
    For j = 1 To 3
      If j = 2 Then Exit For
      count = count + 1
    Next j
  Next i
  If count <> 3 Then Range("A1").Value = "WRONG: " & count
End Sub

End Sub
